description:
Electricity data: every component's power draw, sources and batteries. The data behind https://rust.wiki/calculators/electricity. `consumers` and `logic` list every powered
component with `shortname`, `name`, `draw` (power it needs to run) and `note`; logic parts (switches, gates,
timers, splitters, branches...) have drawn 0 since April 2024. `sources` are the generators (`max` = best-case
output, `sizing` says what that assumes) and `batteries` give `capacity` (rWm) and `max_output` (rW).
`mechanics` explains how Rust power flows; `verified` is when the numbers were last checked and
`sources_cited` where. Fixed data, re-checked after Facepunch balance patches.
name: get_electricity_data
title: Electricity data: every component's power draw, sources and batteries
